products.descriptionLong:
The Oteco Model 72 is a rising-stem gate valve built in Houston for drilling mud systems, standpipe and rig-floor manifolds, flowlines, waterflood injection, crude oil and sour gas service. This listing covers the 2-inch valves — GV224, GV236, GV250 for 2,000, 3,000 and 5,000 psi working pressure — in 59 part numbers that combine the model with its trim and end connections. The valves are rated from −20 °F to 250 °F (−29 °C to 121 °C). Oteco states that Model 72 parts interchange with Cameron Type 'S' Flex-Seal valve parts.

How the valve is built

  • Body subs. The end connections screw into the body, so a valve changes from line pipe thread to butt weld, union or flange by changing the subs, not the body.
  • One-piece forged gate and stem. The stem rises with the gate, so the valve shows open, part-open or closed at a glance.
  • Low operating torque. Large ball bearings and heavy stem threads keep the handwheel load down at full pressure.
  • Gate packing and wear plates. Interlocking packings and wear plates seal the gate and protect the body and cap. Bonded packings, with the wear plates moulded in, are an option.
  • Field renewal. Minor and major repair kits rebuild the valve in line; see Model 72 repair kits, body subs and spare parts.

Trims

Standard service uses a 4130 gate, electroless nickel plated, with nitrile packings. Sour gas (H2S) valves use stainless gates, wear plates and stem packing rings with low-temperature nitrile packings. Waterflood valves (ST, stainless trim) are built for corrosive injection water.

products.descriptionLong:
Threaded, butt-weld, hammer-union and flanged body subs for Oteco Model 72 gate valves — the parts that set the valve's end connections.

Because the Model 72 ends screw into the body, a valve moves to a new connection by changing its two subs. Subs are listed with their connection and service:

  • Threaded: line pipe, EUE, NUE and casing threads.
  • Butt weld: Sch. 80, 160 and XXS, with a 37.5° bevel to ASME B36.10 schedules.
  • Union: male and female Figure 602, 1002 and 1502 subs, made to mate with FMC Weco unions (see Oteco Engineering Bulletin EB-004).
  • Flanged: API ring-joint and ASME raised-face flanges, some xylan coated.

Oteco states that Model 72 gate valve parts are interchangeable with Cameron Type 'S' Flex-Seal valve parts. The Fits column gives the Model 72 valve models (GV224 to GV550, written without the GV) each part is listed for.

products.descriptionLong:
The Oteco DM is a low-cost, in-line repairable gate valve for water, oil and gas service in mud, standpipe and production manifolds. This listing covers the valves with 2-inch end connections, on the 2-inch-port body: DM 22 (2,000 psi), DM 23 (3,000 psi), DM 25 (5,000 psi), DM 28 (7,500 psi, 2-inch ends on the 3-inch body), DM 38 (7,500 psi, 3X2: 3-inch body, 2-inch ends). In the model number the first digit is the end-connection size and the second the pressure class (2 = 2,000, 3 = 3,000, 5 = 5,000 and 8 = 7,500 psi). Where a part name carries two sizes, such as 3X2 or 4X5, they are the body size and the end-connection size.

How the valve is built

  • High-strength weldable cast alloy body and bonnet (A487-4C on the 2-inch body, A487-4D on the larger ones).
  • Corrosion-resistant gate and stem, high-strength steel seat inserts and 90-durometer main seals; Fluorotrel lip-cup stem seals on the 3- and 4-inch bodies.
  • Tight fit tolerances, zinc-chromate plated studs and nuts and extended body-stud thread engagement; the 4-inch body leaves clearance for closed-end wrenches and sockets.
  • Rebuilt in line with minor and major kits — see DM repair kits and DM spare parts.

products.descriptionShort: Oteco 2-inch shear-pin pressure relief valves (PRV), models 20210, 20513, 21027, 21050, 21075, 26010, set 250 to 10,000 psi, line pipe thread or Fig. 1502 union ends, DNV type-approved models — 14 part numbers. Authorised Oteco distributor, UAE stock.
products.descriptionLong:
The Oteco PRV is a shear-pin pressure relief valve that protects mud pumps, discharge manifolds and other drilling equipment from over-pressure. When line pressure reaches the set point, a calibrated shear pin breaks and the valve opens fully to relieve the pump. This listing covers the 2-inch valves, models 20210, 20513, 21027, 21050, 21075, 26010, set from 250 to 10,000 psi.

How it works and how it is built

  • The relief pressure is set by the number and grade of the shear pins. Oteco pins are precision ground and destructively tested in production, which gives a repeatable set point — about ±10 %.
  • A metal chart on every valve gives the shear-pin selection, and a quick-release safety cover gives fast access to replace the pin after the valve has relieved.
  • Hardened stainless stems and stainless liner subs resist corrosion and erosion.
  • Oteco states that PRV relief valve parts are interchangeable with Cameron-style shear relief valve parts.
  • Hammer-union valves have a Figure 1502 female inlet and male outlet, made to mate with FMC Weco unions; some are supplied with mating weld-on union halves. Five of the union valves carry DNV type approval (marked in the table).

products.descriptionLong:
The Oteco Type RR reset relief valve (RRV) protects mud pumps and mud manifolds without shear pins. When pressure passes the set point the valve snaps fully open; it can also be opened by hand with the release button, and the button position shows whether the valve is open or closed. The set pressure is read on an indicator (psi, bar or kPa scales) and adjusted by turning one nut on top of the valve. Vibration does not move the setting, and the fully enclosed bonnet keeps its grease. Accuracy is about ±5 %.

This listing covers the 2-inch Type RR valves for set ranges between 400 and 5,000 psi (28–350 bar), with line pipe, flanged and Figure 1502 union ends. The 2-inch valve has Gullite-plated bonnet components and piston.

Construction

  • Stainless steel piston and cadmium-plated sub; single-piece subs for fewer seals and parts.
  • Standard and sour gas (H2S) service; low-temperature versions in the size table.
  • Oteco states that the RRV bonnet assembly is interchangeable with Cameron Type A and Type B reset relief valves, and offers exchange and rebuilding of Oteco, Cameron Type A and Type B bonnet assemblies.
  • Union ends are made to mate with FMC Weco Figure 1502 unions (Oteco Engineering Bulletin EB-004).

products.title: Oteco Reset Relief Valve (RRV), 3 in, 3,000 to 10,000 psi
products.descriptionShort: Oteco Type RR reset relief valves, 3 in, 3,000 to 10,000 psi: snap-open, manual release, no shear pins, ±5 % — 17 part numbers with flanged and Fig. 1502 union ends. Authorised Oteco distributor, UAE stock.
products.descriptionLong:
The Oteco Type RR reset relief valve (RRV) protects mud pumps and mud manifolds without shear pins. When pressure passes the set point the valve snaps fully open; it can also be opened by hand with the release button, and the button position shows whether the valve is open or closed. The set pressure is read on an indicator (psi, bar or kPa scales) and adjusted by turning one nut on top of the valve. Vibration does not move the setting, and the fully enclosed bonnet keeps its grease. Accuracy is about ±5 %.

This listing covers the heavy 3-inch Type RR valves for 3,000–8,000 psi and 4,000–10,000 psi set ranges — the high-pressure design Oteco verified at an independent laboratory and on pumps from 700 to 3,000 hp. Top cover and sub are heavily flanged, the bonnet base is stiffened, the piston is hydraulically balanced, internal surfaces are xylan coated, and no threads carry load. One-piece subs leave no cross-arms in the flow path, and the discharge port is tuned from flat to round; the flow area is 4.9 in². Main seals are polyethylene and fluoropolymer. Oteco lists 12 ABS design-assessed and 6 DNV design-assessed models in this range.

Construction

  • Stainless steel piston and cadmium-plated sub; single-piece subs for fewer seals and parts.
  • Standard and sour gas (H2S) service; low-temperature versions in the size table.
  • Oteco states that the RRV bonnet assembly is interchangeable with Cameron Type A and Type B reset relief valves, and offers exchange and rebuilding of Oteco, Cameron Type A and Type B bonnet assemblies.
  • Union ends are made to mate with FMC Weco Figure 1502 unions (Oteco Engineering Bulletin EB-004).
